identity.dateBasis: MiniMax X post originally dated October 19 and last edited October 23; HF first full-content commit is corroborating evidence, not proof of first public download
identity.deduplicationReason: Distinct weight-availability stage after the October 19 hosted API rollout; do not combine the two dates or imply unrestricted commercial use.

classification.reason: The dated make model weights public is a product event; scope does not include verified downstream effects.

significance.rationale: An evidenced dated available milestone qualifies for L1; the evidence does not establish executed independent downstream effects.
significance.whyNotHigher: L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS is not satisfied: no supported record of the requisite independent downstream milestone or adoption/replication.
significance.whyNotLower: The primary event fact is supported by quoted sources and separated from vendor outcome claims; the candidate is not merely a search result.

material_access_change.rationale: The reviewed evidence establishes the bounded available event, not the independently established material_access_change milestone required for L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS. Unknown is not a claim of impossibility.

unaffiliated_production_organizations.rationale: The reviewed evidence establishes the bounded available event, not the independently established unaffiliated_production_organizations milestone required for L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS. Unknown is not a claim of impossibility.

consensus.reason: The reviewed announcement/access event is recent; no measured, independently reproduced impact or broad consensus is established.

dispute.reason: No distinct material dispute was established in the bounded reviewed material; absence in a bounded search is not proof none exists.

languageReview.notes: Gemini compared the full English and Simplified Chinese title, summary, narrative and claim text; date, stage, scope and limitations agree. Producer separately checked both languages; this is not a human bilingual sign-off.

limitations: Read-only Gemini review of full retained artifacts in the named Pi session; not an independent live-web reproduction, not human approval, and not publication authorization.
Search captures are bounded multi-result extractions; they are not direct page fetches or full channel coverage. Direct OpenAI announcement returned HTTP 403; no bypass.
PublishedAt is omitted for sources without an independently established source-publication date; event date is not substituted for source date.

Gemini full-review text includes extraneous/overbroad language (e.g. five independent reporting outlets for the OpenAI event); the retained package supports three named news publishers, an interested company repository, and AGMAI’s own statement. Those reviewer embellishments are not adopted as fact.
A previous review of the pre-fix run is superseded; only the named session accepting the current run digest is cited here.
This published-state wrapper is a provisional proposal; Gemini accepted the unchanged factual draft, not an executed release. The publication date is planned, not historical, until release completes.
